reason: The analyst ran one specification on an unjustified north-only subsample with 1% outcome trimming. The report claims a firm-age control that the code does not include, and it omits the other pre-period confounders. The resulting 'no effect' (0.54, SE 0.38) is an imprecise estimate from a restricted sample, not evidence of zero. My full-sample analysis with full pre-period controls gives a similar null (0.05, SE 0.25), but the analyst's own specification and report are not reliable enough to release.
